summary.text: Jason Woolford is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 50 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Jason Woolford's general-election opponent is Cassie Canedo (D).
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps and has worked as a chief executive officer.

paragraphs.text: Jason Woolford was born in Howell, Michigan, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1992 to 1995.
His career experience includes working as a chief executive officer.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was appointed president of Mission Cry an International in 2010 and that he received a master's degree in divinity.
Woolford assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2025, and in 2025-2026 is assigned to the Families, Children, and Seniors Committee and the House Oversight Committee.
In the same survey, he listed his key campaign messages as requiring every county to use water-marked ballots, banning gender-transition surgery for minors, and closing the border.
